name: 郭五鳳
objective: This course, Integrated and Cross-Functional Management, provides an integrated overview of core business management functions, including marketing management, sales management, project management, supply chain management, and logistics management. The course emphasizes cross-functional coordination, managerial decision-making, and leadership skills necessary for effective organizational performance. Students will learn why integration is critical in competitive business environments. Real-world examples will demonstrate the consequences of poor coordination. Students develop analytical and practical competencies through case studies, applied exercises, and a team-based capstone project.
